description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface. It provides methods to create and manage ADO.NET-based queue adapters for Orleans streaming, including handling queries, cache, and queue mapping. The class includes factory methods for creating adapter, failure handler, and queue adapter instances, and manages dependencies such as stream options, cluster options, and service provider.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Implements IQueueAdapterFactory to create and manage ADO.NET queue adapters for Orleans streaming, including query management, cache, and queue mapping.

methods.name: GetQueriesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads or retrieves cached relational Orleans queries, ensuring they are loaded only once with concurrency control.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates an IQueueAdapter instance asynchronously using the factory method and current configuration.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a stream failure handler for a specific queue, asynchronously.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used by the queue adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used by the adapter.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory using service provider and stream name.
